"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"As the second largest socialist organization in US history, the Democratic Socialists of America has a unique opportunity to organize Democratic Socialists of America members.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Inquiries regarding work, rent, consumption, and sociality should be continually conducted for Democratic Socialists of America members.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Inquiries should be conducted for those external to the Democratic Socialists of America, so that ways of empowering others in the working class can be found.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Socialists of America can begin inquiries with those close to Democratic Socialists of America members, like co-workers, neighbors, friends, and associates.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Socialists of America must retain an outward-looking stance if it wants to grow and develop solidarities throughout the working class.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"As the working class gains a shared sense of trust and organizational strength, a path to victory will be built.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The working class is international.",
